stemMd: If P(x)=2x cubed−x+1, what is P(−2)?
explanationMd: Substitute carefully: 2 times (−8)−(−2)+1=−16+2+1=−13. Odd powers preserve the negative sign of the input.

distractorRationale.b: This fails to reverse the sign of −x at x=−2.
distractorRationale.e: This omits the +2 from the linear term.
distractorRationale.c: This loses the negative sign of the odd power.
